qualityFinding.issue: A paragraph mixes general lithium-ion operating guidance with an LFP cooling experiment but selects only the general-guidance passage. Citation identity validation does not establish whole-claim entailment.
qualityFinding.causation: Two stochastic samples cannot establish that aliases caused this failure. No scientific-quality improvement or equivalence is claimed.

nextOptimizationOrder: Measure first checked section and final completion separately on organic tasks, separating queue/cold-start and provider wait.
Keep re-opening a saved note distinct from generating fresh research; no semantic cache across private or stale questions.
Strengthen claim/passage evaluation before trying a faster model, less evidence or parallel generation.
Consider bounded parallel retrieval and worker capacity only with concurrency/accounting checks and measured budget headroom.
overlapConclusion: One Pinterest pair: the post-stream tail fell from 3.78s to 1.94s with more checks. Provider wait varied more than the saving; no percentile or end-to-end speedup is established.
